prompt_summary: Edit the real Yulin city reference into a 3:1, restrained architectural photography panorama. Built city and roads dominate, with approximately 80% urban content and only a small restored riverbank green corridor. Preserve recognizable local architectural scale, avoid fantasy towers, painting strokes and plastic rendering. No baked-in white vignette, titles or frame. Edge feathering and slight transparency are applied in CSS.
